quote: C/o abnormal gait and foot pain bilat.
proposition: The pre-neurology record presents gait and bilateral foot pain together rather than as two already-separated pathways.
significance: Entry-state evidence for the integrated feet–gait problem.

quote: neurology opinion of his gait, feet and "muscle tension" issues
proposition: The GP referral question expressly integrated gait, feet and pathological muscle tension.
significance: Shows the integrated phenotype that entered Neurology before any later documentary partition.

quote: Marked increased tone both legs
proposition: Pathological lower-limb tone was documented before admission alongside the gait/feet referral.
significance: Adds the tone component to the integrated entry phenotype.

quote: footdrop appearance somewhat suggestive of a dystonic posture - NOT FOOT DROP
proposition: Neurology itself documented an abnormal lower-limb gait phenomenon suggestive of dystonic posture.
significance: A neurological lower-limb observation capable of bearing on the clinical meaning of the feet; it should not be retrospectively treated as proof that a feet–neurology relationship had already been adequately investigated.

quote: may have been completely separate or perhaps a secondary peripheral neuropathy
tertiary_quote: he has in his own mind - markedly divorced the feelings of tension in the legs
proposition: The authored synthesis constructs a separate/peripheral-neuropathy foot channel, ends it 'Not clear', and attributes a stronger separation state to the patient's own mind.
significance: The core documentary junction is not merely an unresolved relationship. It is the point at which the synthesis durably allocates the feet away from the Parkinsonian/PRKN construction while preserving a different neurological possibility through neuropathy.

quote: firmer footing going forward for having a plan
proposition: The portable account represented a firm forward plan and an exceptionally capable, insightful patient.
significance: Part of the compatible patient knowledge-state and management account that travelled forward.

quote: has a good understanding of why we wished to delay the commencement of levodopa
proposition: The document recorded patient understanding of the delayed-levodopa strategy.
significance: A genuine but bounded understanding statement that later becomes part of the historical justification; it does not establish acceptance that the feet had been adequately dealt with.

quote: So are you telling me you’re going to bring me in here, give me the full NCT, and send me out on bald tires?
proposition: Before closure, the patient directly challenged the completeness of the neurological work because the feet had not been properly dealt with. The Protest is an established case fact.
significance: The Protest is not best described as contesting a separation already understood by the patient. It forces the unfinished foot component of the phenotype back into view and creates the decision point: reopen the neurological question or proceed without doing so. The final synthesis omits this event.

document: Contemporaneous patient email during procyclidine withdrawal
quote: My walk is back together.
secondary_quote: during withdrawal, tension increased, the feet became restless and gait deteriorated
proposition: The treatment/withdrawal experiment altered gait, tension and foot state together.
status: contemporaneous patient evidence with forensic source-status annotation
significance: An early boundary test of the partition constructed at discharge; it does not by itself prove a single mechanism.

quote: feet issues in relating to increased tone and abnormal gait relating to Parkinson's disease
proposition: Primary care explicitly reconnected the feet with increased tone and abnormal gait in the Parkinsonian context.
significance: Independent longitudinal control regenerating the integrated formulation.

quote: we do these letter is in real-time, which [Patient] will have at home, so that we have a shared understanding of what I mean
proposition: The letters were expressly described as instruments for creating a shared understanding of the clinician's meaning.
significance: Shows that later letters were not merely passive history; they also stabilised communicated interpretation.

quote: He is well aware of the impulse control disorder concerns
secondary_quote: [Patient] has been fully counselled on all of the above
tertiary_quote: As I have reminded him, the DBS is only ever for the tremor element
proposition: Later letters repeatedly recorded awareness, counselling and prior knowledge; the same passage records the DBS discussion and 'if he wishes' candidacy language.
significance: Later knowledge-state specimen and an independent DBS provenance stress test.

quote: the leg pain and shuffling is off related
proposition: Movement Disorders documentation characterised leg pain and shuffling as OFF-related.
significance: A later treatment-state observation crossing the 2017 partition.

quote: severe bilateral "burning" both feet and lower legs and pain
secondary_quote: the pains settled with better control of his parkinsons
proposition: The GP again connected severe bilateral foot/lower-leg pain with the longitudinal Parkinsonian treatment context.
significance: An independent later boundary test and notice event.

quote: once the Sinemet hits his system that the feet feel better from a pain perspective
proposition: Neurology recorded a reproducible relationship between Sinemet state and foot pain and introduced controlled-release Sinemet overnight.
significance: A late boundary test directly involving the feet and dopaminergic state.

quote: As the letters show, we have had a clear understanding for quite some time that Sinemet does help his pain.
secondary_quote: Sinemet CR, which has provided him with profound relief currently
proposition: The 2025 response relied on the letters and a claimed longstanding shared understanding while accepting profound current relief from Sinemet CR.
significance: The closing documentary loop: historical continuity is offered as evidence answering a challenge to the historical pathway.

quote: Why was this possibility not explored earlier, given the magnitude of harm endured?
proposition: The 2025 complaint directly challenged the historical framing and requested reconstruction of the pathway in light of the treatment response.
status: primary contemporaneous notice document; propositions inside remain the patient's positions unless independently established
significance: The later challenge that closes the 2017–2025 documentary loop.

quote: Specific PARK 2 PRKN which we/Prof Healy suspect is the cause
proposition: The record documents a specific PRKN/PARK2 causal suspicion.
significance: One side of an independent diagnostic-continuity stress test and evidence that PRKN/PARK2 was an active explanatory possibility.

quote: it is our belief and understanding that [Patient] has idiopathic Parkinson's disease
proposition: The 2025 response states the diagnosis as idiopathic Parkinson's disease.
significance: The other side of the PRKN → idiopathic Parkinson's disease provenance question.

quote: there is a "misalignment" between the two of us
secondary_quote: very reasonable and justifiable concerns that a lot of this relates to the feet as a separate problem
proposition: A later letter expressly records a clinician/patient misalignment about whether the feet are a separate problem and how the Parkinsonian framework explains the symptoms.
significance: A later contrary knowledge-state showing that agreement cannot be inferred globally from generic understanding language.
